payload.title: Newsroom home without a Needs me nav entry
payload.description: Ryan 11-02: the newsroom home is the wordmark's page, with no Needs me navigation entry. PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1078 (branch feature/newsroom-home-nav, not merged). Removes the entry from sidebar, More menu and bottom tabs; top-bar wordmark opens the home; titles say Newsroom home; banner reworded to 'Each answer is saved as a label for the Cyclotron.' (votes do not retrain the hosted classifier); bottom tabs centre for any count; phone More menu gets a Back to <site> link (desktop has none now). Gherkin in features/newsroom-notification-center.feature. Open: 'The line is learned from the predictions you confirm' in How this is ordered is a computed median threshold, left as is.
